## Welcome

I'm Dr Ian Henry, a licensed UK radio amateur living just south of Cambridge,
and a member of [Cambridge and District Amateur Radio Club (CDARC)](https://www.cdarc.org.uk/)
and the [Radio Society of Great Britain (RSGB)](https://rsgb.org/).

If you've found your way here from one of my
[RadCom articles or talks](talks.qmd), welcome. They're all listed on the
[Talks & Publications](talks.qmd) page, including
*Understanding FT8 through DNA-sequencing parallels* and the
[blog post](blog-posts/2026-04-25-ft8_dna_radcom.qmd) that goes with it.

If you'd like to get in touch, collaborate, or talk radio, you can find contact
details in the footer.

## Teaching, learning, and amateur radio

This site brings together reflective writing, theory, practical guides, and the
things I'm building, all focused on teaching, SDR, and modern amateur radio
practice.

You'll find:

- [**Projects**](projects.qmd): packet radio infrastructure, machine learning
  for signal identification, and SDR builds
- [**Blog**](blog.qmd): posts exploring ideas and experiences
- [**Thinking**](thinking.qmd): theory-focused writing on learning and SDR
- [**Guides**](guides.qmd): practical guides for applying those ideas
- [**Notebook**](notebook.qmd): working notes, speculative and self-correcting
- [**Talks & Publications**](talks.qmd): articles and conference sessions

There's more about me and how I got here on the [About](about.qmd) page.
